  • Method Details

    • restore

      public static Schema restore(Schema base, Schema projection, Set<Integer> fieldIds)
      Restores columns from a base schema in a projection that may not include them.
      Parameters:
      base - a base schema, from which the projection was produced
      projection - a projection of the base schema
      fieldIds - a set of field IDs to add to the projection if they are missing
      Returns:
      an updated projection with the fields restored
